description: The image is a three-dimensional axonometric diagram titled "Diagram 44 Location of LPG cylinders". It shows a length of external wall with a "Door" at the left end and an "Openable element of a window" at the right. Three LPG cylinders stand side by side on a low base in front of the wall, each with a valve on top. An "Air Intake or flue terminal" is mounted high on the wall to the left of the cylinders, and an "Airbrick" is set low in the wall to the right of them. Two "Untrapped drain or cellar opening" features appear at floor level, one to the left of the wall and one to the right. Dimension lines mark X (horizontal, drawn from the terminal and from the window toward a cylinder valve), Y (vertical, from window level down to a valve), W (vertical, from floor level up to the airbrick), and Z (horizontal, from the nearest cylinder valve toward the drain opening on the left). A note at the bottom lists "Minimum dimensions:" W = 250mm, X = 1m, Y = 300mm, Z = 2m, with a brace reading "Measured from nearest cylinder valve".
